vulnerable_code:
class ReceiptsController < ApplicationController
  def view_blob
    # Fetches ActiveStorage::Blob directly without invoice ownership check
    blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.find(params[:blob_id])
    send_data blob.download, filename: blob.filename.to_s, type: blob.content_type
  end
end
diagnosis: The view_blob action downloads an ActiveStorage::Blob directly by ID without connecting it to an authorized Invoice record. Any authenticated customer can access receipt PDFs and point-of-sale invoice images of other platform customers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/receipts/blobs/blob_3310 HTTP/1.1
Host: pos.merchantpay.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_cookie_token
Accept: application/pdf
corrected_code:
class ReceiptsController < ApplicationController
  def view_blob
    invoice = current_user.invoices.joins(:receipt_attachment).find_by!(
      active_storage_attachments: { blob_id: params[:blob_id] }
    )
    blob = invoice.receipt.blob
    send_data blob.download, filename: blob.filename.to_s, type: blob.content_type
  end
end
